title: S1: language seam and command contract for Python (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2) slice S1: a LanguageIndexer seam over the TypeScript indexer with no behaviour change for TypeScript-only repositories, language detection, --language, one language per run, coverage-line entry for languages not indexed, additive contract fields recorded in ADR 0002. No Python indexer and no new dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.text: TypeScript-only output is byte-identical to dev, proven by a test that fails if it changes
--language and detection select one language per run; a language not indexed is named with its file count in the coverage line; an unregistered language is a clear usage error, never a silent empty
--language is declared in help --json; language and notIndexed are declared in the ADR 0002 amendment and the README (the help --json manifest has no slot for output fields)
bun run check and lore check are green

implementationNotes: S1 implementation 2baa698 (rules commit 6176810, tracker 33f2004); Opus review at 33f2004 returned CHANGES (B1-B4 + should-fix), follow-up commit on this branch. Scope note (B2): --ref and code-map still build TypeScript only through indexSnapshot (src/snapshot.ts), not through the LanguageIndexer seam; S7 owns wiring Python into them. The --ref path reports notIndexed from the ref's tree listing. Python-only repository keeps dev's exit 3 not_found, naming python and its file count, until S7 registers Python indexing (reviewer ruling B1). AC2 reading (B4): the help --json manifest has no slot for output fields, so only the --language flag is declared there; language and notIndexed are recorded in the ADR 0002 amendment and the README, and AC2 is not checked as written. ADR 0008 is not on origin/dev at this SHA (merge-order dependency on docs/GCLI-68-adr-0008-native-python); the ADR 0002 amendment cites it in prose. Verified by the worker under the pinned bun 1.4.2 at 33f2004: bun run check 282 pass, 0 fail; lore check 0/0.

AC position 3 re-scoped (reviewer decision, the criterion could not be met as written: the manifest has no slot for output fields) and checked on the new wording. Evidence at cc470138: help --json declares --language (test 'help --json publishes --language as a value-taking global flag naming the registry'); language and notIndexed are recorded in the ADR 0002 amendment (2026-11-23) and the README Languages section. Opus review round 2 at cc47013 returned CHANGES C1 (non-Git walk excluded-dir change for TypeScript) and C2 (hostile git config test cannot fail) plus should-fix; follow-up commit on this branch. Verified by the worker at cc47013 under pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run check 291 pass 0 fail; lore check 0/0.

Opus round 3 at d33ffe4: APPROVE (merge conditional on CI green on the pushed SHA and the push order cleared). Verified by the worker at d33ffe4 under pinned bun 1.4.2: bun run check 293 pass, 0 fail; lore check 0/0; package.json and bun.lock untouched; discover.ts EXCLUDED_DIRS equal to dev. ACs 1, 2, 4 checked on this evidence (byte-identity goldens incl. human/stream/ref/cache-hit with mutation proofs; detection, --language, not-indexed coverage entry, exit-2 unregistered, exit-3 Python-only naming the count; check green). NITS to ride in ONE later docs/comment-only commit on this branch (the leader checks by ref that it touches only comments, README, ADR and the tracker record): (a) src/snapshot.ts languageFilesAtRef doc says excluded paths do not arise at a ref, but groupByLanguage applies the Python segment rule there (a ref can carry tracked node_modules/ or venv/ paths): fix the comment; (b) ADR 0002 sentence that acceptance criterion 2 cannot be checked as written is stale (re-scoped and checked) and criterion 2 is ambiguous: reword to the criterion text; (c) README: one sentence on the Python directory rule (tracked .py under any venv/.venv/__pycache__/.tox segment is not counted, so a nested tools/venv/x.py or a package named venv is dropped; a TS repo whose only Python is there gets no notIndexed entry; a Python-only repo like that gets dev no TypeScript or JavaScript sources found message); (d) src/contract.ts comment this string is computed once is loose: only GLOBAL_FLAGS[language].summary (the help --json value) is frozen at load, buildProgram gets a live value; (e) note for S7: discoverFiles passes the full path to accept in its Git branch and the basename in its walk branch (harmless for extension checks, a path-based check would differ); optional: assert non-GlyphError / exit 1 in test/language.test.ts for the indexWith guard, and a test with a tracked venv/x.py in a Git tree and at a ref.
